footer.about: Mondapac is a Brisbane marketplace for local food sellers: halal butchers, bakers, pantry makers and more. Every product shows where it comes from, and certificates such as halal are checked by our team before a label appears. Prices include GST, and each seller shows its own delivery window and minimum order.

consent.title: Cookies on Mondapac
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart and settings. With your permission we also remember what you view and search for, to suggest products. You can change this at any time.
consent.error: We could not save your choice. Try again.

cookies.title: Cookie settings
cookies.intro: Choose which cookies Mondapac may use on this device. Necessary cookies are always on because the shop does not work without them. Your choice is kept for one year.
cookies.necessary-body: These keep the shop working. They hold no record of what you look at.

list.session-body: Keeps you signed in to your account.
list.cart-body: Remembers your cart before you sign in.
list.palette-body: Remembers the colours you chose in Personalization.
list.text-size-body: Remembers the text size you chose.
list.consent-body: Remembers the choice you make on this page.

cookies.personalization-body: Remembers the products you view, search for and add to your cart for 30 days, so we can suggest products for you. Turning it off deletes this cookie.
